description.value: A family-run Japanese restaurant in Prince Rupert's Cow Bay tourist district, operating for over 25 years out of one of the last remaining net lofts on the coast. Founded in 1998 by Yoshi Nakamura who was drawn by the fresh local seafood and clean air, it has won the Dining Distinction Award in 2024 and 2025. The restaurant features a patio, serves Canadian and international beer, wine, and spirits, and is available for private events and catering.

address.value: 34 Cowbay Road, Prince Rupert, BC V8J 1A5
